description: Placement of capped-group outputs relative to the merged rating c; diagnostic of why exact-target models rank the capped group poorly.

definitions.capped_group: charts whose original rating is >= c (the paper's hidden-tail panel)
definitions.near_fraction: share of capped-group rating-scale outputs with |output - c| <= delta
definitions.near_rho: Spearman correlation between original rating and latent_score among near-cap charts (undefined when fewer than 5 charts)
definitions.median_by_original: median rating-scale output of capped charts by original rating
definitions.above_fraction: share of capped-group rating-scale outputs with output > c + delta
definitions.near_rho_macro_rule: near_rho macros only when near_count >= 30 and every bootstrap replicate defines it
definitions.rank_tie_pair_fraction: share of capped-group chart pairs with exactly equal latent_score
definitions.sequence_scores: Transformer cap-8 scores are the frozen three-seed ensemble in the public artifact; caps 7/9 are single seed
